cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Apologize Properly
cards.instruction: Get someone to deliver the apology in the form, order, and setting you consider valid.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Apologise for eating my cake at the table where it happened. I taught you to face the person you owe an answer, not mumble from the doorway.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Clearer than your old apologies. Now take it over to the cake plate; that was the rehearsal.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your dad's sitting there. Can't we do this privately?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He watched me blame the dog. First tell him you ate it. Then apologise to me; you always tried to skip the difficult sentence.
